bibl.title: The Speaker and the Addressee of Sophocles' Tereus Fr. 588 Radt and the Context of Fr. 583.
bibl.seg: Daniel Libatique, The Speaker and the Addressee of Sophocles' Tereus Fr. 588 Radt and the Context of Fr. 583.
bibl.note: Suggests that Procne's addressee of fr. 588 is the Shepherd and that fr. 583 forms part of a lament for Philomela whose death has been an established event for some time.
